messages:
maya: Heads-up: Customer-Alpha wants a compact observability beta: per-route cost estimates + lightweight trace hooks + error grouping. Need launch gates and a cut plan.
aj: Minimal approach: sampled cost by route+model, span attrs for route_id only in canary region, error sigs aggregated server-side.
frank: Perf check needed. Adding span attrs can affect p95. If p95 delta >5% we must disable traces.
denise: They care about model+route split now; dataset-level later. Also want canary in their dedicated region (no telemetry leaving).
samira: UI: display "estimated" with CI and a small "sampled" badge. Toggle to enable canary region widgets.
elena: Sampling: recommend adaptive sampling tiers (0.5/1/5%) based on route QPS so low-volume routes aren't useless.
maya: Proposed gates:
- p95 latency regression <5%
- cost estimator within 20% for top 80% traffic
- security review for canary region
Fallback: if gate fails, keep cost estimates but disable trace links.
aj: Engineering tasks: span schema PR (route_id), dataplane propagation, small index for error sigs.
frank: I'll run microbench for hook overhead. If >3us/token, reduce sampling for non-critical routes.
denise: I'll confirm beta region and legal constraints today.
samira: I'll prep placeholder widgets and region-flag UI (5 days).
elena: I'll ship a prototype estimator and sampling plan (7 days).
infra-bot: Deploy notice: runtime-kernel v2.14 rolling in 36h; will post perf after.
maya: Action owners ack?
aj: ack
frank: ack
denise: ack
samira: ack
elena: ack
maya: Thanks. Next sync 48h after kernel rollout. Ping me for blockers.
